entries.claim: The exact pinned Latin Mass body corroborates the complete Gospel as a derived digital comparison witness. This unit is direct, not inherited and not an independent controlling print; its thirteen accidentals are declared in the apparatus.

The Benziger Brothers 1962 Editio iuxta typicam page prints the complete 153-word Gospel on p. 467, leaf n548, from the lower left into the upper right column, ending with Israel before Credo. Framing is excluded; no shared expansion is supplied.
